name: Banyan Tree Mayakoba
positioning: All-private-pool villa resort set within the protected mangroves and freshwater lagoons of Mayakoba on the Riviera Maya, with direct access to the Caribbean coast
best_for: Couples who want a villa or suite with its own private pool
Nature lovers who want canals, mangroves, a nature trail and a guests-only cenote
Families wanting multi-bedroom residences and a Kid's Club by the beach

facts.text: Every villa and suite has a private pool and spacious outdoor living areas.
The resort blends local Mexican traditions and hospitality with Asian culture.
The resort has a white-sand beachfront that guests can use for swimming and snorkeling.
In the Family Residences, a rooftop solarium has a pool overlooking the golf course.
The Serenity Pool Villa with Living Room has Talavera-glazed earthenware sinks.
The spa's Rainforest is a hydrothermal experience inspired by Asian and European healing traditions.
Spa therapists are trained at the Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy in Phuket.
Saffron is the resort's signature Thai restaurant.
Complimentary bicycles let guests ride through jungle trails, along canals and to the beach.
Mayakoba's three-mile nature trail winds through mangroves and lagoons, with bird-watching towers.
The Kid's Club is located at Sands Beach Club.

highlights.text: Banyan Tree Mayakoba is an all-private-pool villa resort set within the protected mangroves and freshwater lagoons of Mayakoba, with direct access to the Caribbean coast.
The Lagoon & Sunset Rooftop Pool Villa is a two-storey over-the-water villa steps from the white-sand beach.
The spa offers a Temazcal ritual, an ancient Mesoamerican ceremony led by a shaman inside a sacred dome with volcanic stones and healing herbs.
A complimentary ecotour through the canals offers sightings of wildlife such as birds, turtles and crocodiles.
Mayakoba has a cenote called Burrodromo that is exclusive to Mayakoba guests.

considerations.text: At night, Saffron, Cello, Tomahawk and Sands Beach Club recommend elegant-casual attire, and beach shorts and flip-flops are not permitted.
The resort is a 20-minute drive from downtown Playa del Carmen.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's ultra-luxury positioning.
